They see OrbitFlow as a workflow layer for business-owned processes, not a replacement for Workato. Pricing was flagged as high against a Zapier benchmark. Jon demoed the builder, run history, and AI steps. Security requirements are light (SOC 2, SSO, audit logs). The pilot needs a representative workflow, a sandbox, and a Workato comparison. Acme plans to choose a vendor by end of July with first workflows live in September.
